ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a central carbon atom skeleton; the central position is respectively connected to H2N at the upper left, O-H at the upper right, OR^1 at the lower right, and R at the lower left; at the upper left there is also a separate H+ species. There are curved arrows in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring the arrows. Reasoning: Represent both variable groups R and R^1 with the SMILES wildcard *. R^1 corresponds to an alkoxy side chain, so it can be written as *O- connected to the central carbon; the central carbon also has an R wildcard branch *, an amino group N, and a hydroxyl group O. The separate proton is written as an independent component [H+], separated from the main structure with a dot. Therefore the SMILES is *OC(*)(N)O.[H+].

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First describe the visual structure: identify the central carbon and its bonded groups H2N, OH, OR1, and R, plus the separate H+ species, while disregarding the curved arrows. Convert R and R1 to wildcard atoms in SMILES. Choose a connected skeleton where the R1 alkoxy side is '*O-' attached to the central carbon, the R substituent is another '*' branch on the central carbon, and the amino and hydroxyl substituents are '(N)' and 'O'. Then append the separate proton component after a dot, giving '*OC(*)(N)O.[H+]'.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中有一个中心碳原子骨架，中心位置分别连接到左上的 H2N、右上的 O-H、右下的 OR^1，以及左下的 R；左上方还有一个单独的 H+ 物种。图中有弯曲箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头。推理：将可变基团 R 和 R^1 都用 SMILES 通配符 * 表示。R^1 对应烷氧基侧链，因此可写成 *O- 连接到中心碳；中心碳还带有一个 R 通配符分支 *、一个氨基 N 和一个羟基 O。单独的质子作为独立组分写为 [H+]，用点号与主结构分开。因此 SMILES 为 *OC(*)(N)O.[H+]。
